mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 52 degrees with clear skies observed at Harriet Park. The Waning Crescent moon is out tonight, and we are looking at an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Public Works department is introducing a new leaf vacuum truck for the fall season to help with collection, and building inspectors are reminding residents to check in before starting any new structural projects.

There is plenty to do in town, starting tomorrow with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and Yoga at Insight Wellness happening later this week.
In the weekly police report, officers noted that on October 3, a 19 year old Verona man was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following a traffic stop for expired registration.

The Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the night after serving up Chocolate Caramel Twist today. Be sure to stop by tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM to enjoy tomorrow's featured flavor, Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
